{{Top|leg}}
A '''minilab''' was capable of analyzing chemical and biological samples, although with less accuracy than laboratory facilities aboard [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. It could give a [[Scout/Legends|scout]] a rough analysis of of a substance's elemental structure, age and secondary compounds. It was also effective at storing samples under laboratory conditions until they could be transferred to a better facility.
